summary: Sets a network session parameter at index a1 from the string value lpMem. Parses the input into components, allocates a copy, swaps the session table slot (dword_5E64F4 + 3 * a1) and an associated 6-byte config entry, then dispatches a per-index validation callback. On validation failure the previous slot value, config entry and CodePage are restored and the copy is freed. Special index 2 updates the global CodePage and index 1 updates dword_8D3F4C. Returns the new session table slot on success, 0 on parse/allocation/validation failure.

Free the previously stored session table pointer: if v12 != &unk_5E63E0 then sub_58AA6F(v12).
Return the new session table entry *(&dword_5E64F4 + 3 * a1) on success.
